label: Dementia register
description: Patients with a recorded diagnosis of dementia (QOF dementia register).

label: Dementia register (65+)
description: Patients aged 65 and over with a recorded diagnosis of dementia.

label: Dementia register (under 65)
description: Patients currently aged under 65 with a recorded diagnosis of dementia. Not the same as young onset.

label: Estimated dementia population (65+)
description: Expected number of people aged 65 and over with dementia (CFAS II prevalence rates).

label: Diagnosis rate (65+)
description: Recorded dementia register (65+) as a percentage of the estimated dementia population (65+).

label: Diagnosis rate (65+) lower 95% limit
description: Lower 95% confidence limit of the diagnosis rate.

label: Diagnosis rate (65+) upper 95% limit
description: Upper 95% confidence limit of the diagnosis rate.

label: Young onset dementia
description: Patients whose dementia diagnosis was recorded before the age of 65 (any current age). Called early onset before Nov 2023.

label: New diagnoses (incidence)
description: Patients newly diagnosed with dementia in the period. A monthly count until Mar 2026 and a quarterly count from Jun 2026 (not comparable).

label: Mild cognitive impairment (40+)
description: Patients aged 40 and over with a diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment (it is only counted from age 40). From Apr 2024.

label: Mild cognitive impairment (65+)
description: Patients aged 65 and over with a diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment. From Apr 2023.

label: Mild cognitive impairment (40-64)
description: Patients aged 40 to 64 with a diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment. From mid 2024.

label: Mild cognitive impairment by age
description: Patients with mild cognitive impairment by age band (from age 40). From mid 2024.

label: Mild cognitive impairment by sex
description: Patients aged 40 and over with mild cognitive impairment by sex. From mid 2024.

label: Dementia register by age
description: Dementia register by age band. Monthly releases cover 65+ bands only; quarterly releases cover all ages.

label: Dementia register (65+) by sex
description: Dementia register aged 65 and over by sex.

label: Dementia register by sex
description: Dementia register (all ages) by sex. From Jun 2026 (earlier releases give 65+ only).

label: Dementia register by ethnicity
description: Dementia register by latest recorded ethnic group.

label: Dementia register by dementia type
description: Dementia register by most recent dementia type. Other specified / not recorded categories from Apr 2025.

label: Dementia register by residence type
description: Dementia register by most recent residence type.

label: Registered patients
description: Patients registered at GP practices.

label: Registered patients (65+)
description: Registered patients aged 65 and over.

label: Registered patients (under 65)
description: Registered patients aged under 65.

label: Registered patients (40+)
description: Registered patients aged 40 and over (the population for mild cognitive impairment).

label: Comorbidities
description: Patients with dementia and one or more of diabetes, stroke, hypertension or coronary heart disease. Monthly releases only.

label: Palliative care
description: Patients aged 65 and over with dementia who are on the QOF palliative care register.

label: Delirium (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia and a diagnosis of delirium recorded in the last 12 months.

label: Received care plan (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia who received a care plan or care plan review in the last 12 months.

label: Declined care plan (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia who declined a care plan or care plan review in the last 12 months.

label: Medication reviews
description: Medication reviews in the period (derived from the financial-year-to-date count). Suppressed at many practices before 2026/27.

label: Medication reviews (financial year to date)
description: Patients with a care plan review who received a medication review since 1 April. Suppressed at many practices before 2026/27.

label: GP dementia assessments
description: Patients who received a GP assessment for dementia in the period. Monthly releases only.

label: GP dementia assessments (financial year to date)
description: Patients who received a GP assessment for dementia since 1 April. Monthly releases only.

label: Declined GP dementia assessment (RDD only)
description: Patients who declined a GP assessment for dementia in the period. Recorded Dementia Diagnoses only (to Sep 2022).

label: Declined GP dementia assessment (financial year to date; RDD only)
description: Patients who declined a GP assessment for dementia since 1 April. Recorded Dementia Diagnoses only (to Sep 2022).

label: Received memory assessment
description: Patients assessed who received a GP memory assessment in the period. Monthly releases only.

label: Received memory assessment (financial year to date)
description: Patients assessed who received a GP memory assessment since 1 April. Monthly releases only.

label: Declined memory assessment
description: Patients assessed who declined a GP memory assessment in the period. Monthly releases only.

label: Declined memory assessment (financial year to date)
description: Patients assessed who declined a GP memory assessment since 1 April. Monthly releases only.

label: Received memory clinic referral
description: Patients assessed who received a memory clinic referral in the period. Monthly releases only.

label: Received memory clinic referral (financial year to date)
description: Patients assessed who received a memory clinic referral since 1 April. Monthly releases only.

label: Declined memory clinic referral
description: Patients assessed who declined a memory clinic referral in the period. Monthly releases only.

label: Declined memory clinic referral (financial year to date)
description: Patients assessed who declined a memory clinic referral since 1 April. Monthly releases only.

label: Memory clinic referrals: patients (last 12 months)
description: Number of patients referred to a memory clinic in the last 12 months. Each patient counts once, however many times they were referred. From 2026/27.

label: Memory clinic referrals: total referrals (last 12 months)
description: Number of referrals to a memory clinic in the last 12 months. A patient referred twice counts twice, so this is always at least the number of patients referred. From 2026/27.

label: Falls (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia who had a fall in the last 12 months. From 2026/27.

label: Hip fracture (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia who had a fractured neck of femur in the last 12 months. From 2026/27.

label: Mild frailty
description: Patients with dementia and a diagnosis of mild frailty. From 2026/27.

label: Moderate frailty
description: Patients with dementia and a diagnosis of moderate frailty. From 2026/27.

label: Severe frailty
description: Patients with dementia and a diagnosis of severe frailty. From 2026/27.

label: Donepezil, rivastigmine or galantamine (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia prescribed donepezil, rivastigmine or galantamine in the last 12 months. From 2026/27.

label: Memantine (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia prescribed memantine in the last 12 months. From 2026/27.

label: Memantine in combination (last 12 months)
description: Patients with dementia prescribed memantine with donepezil, rivastigmine or galantamine in the last 12 months. From 2026/27.

label: No psychosis diagnosis
description: Patients on the dementia register without a recorded diagnosis of psychosis. From Jun 2026 (earlier monthly figures were mostly suppressed and are not shown).

label: Antipsychotics without psychosis diagnosis
description: Patients without a psychosis diagnosis prescribed antipsychotics in the six weeks to the period end. From Jun 2026 (earlier monthly figures were mostly suppressed and are not shown).

label: Psychosis diagnosis
description: Patients on the dementia register with a recorded diagnosis of psychosis. From Jun 2026 (earlier monthly figures were mostly suppressed and are not shown).

label: Antipsychotics with psychosis diagnosis
description: Patients with a psychosis diagnosis prescribed antipsychotics in the six weeks to the period end. From Jun 2026 (earlier monthly figures were mostly suppressed and are not shown).
